shouldTake.label: Tone of written student reviews (85 on file)

COLWRIT R1A.sentiment: Reviews are divided. Many describe a heavy, time-consuming writing workload with harsh grading and repeated revisions, plus some complaints about vague expectations. Others say the detailed feedback and revisions made them better writers. Experience seems to vary a lot by instructor.

shouldTake.label: Tone of written student reviews (67 on file)

COLWRIT R4A.sentiment: Reviews are mostly negative and depend on the instructor. Students describe vague prompts, strict or inconsistent grading, discouraging feedback, and heavy workload with frequent office hours needed. A few say the class is supportive with chances to revise, and that effort and participation pay off.

shouldTake.label: Tone of written student reviews (96 on file)

COLWRIT R4B.sentiment: Students describe a very demanding writing course with heavy workload, many assignments, and harsh grading. Some value the detailed feedback and freedom to choose research topics, while many report an unsupportive, inflexible environment and say they would take a different section. Reviews are sharply divided and lean negative.
